facts.fact: Benin's ID4Africa deck describes the National Interoperability Platform (PNI, XROAD BJ), an X-Road based service bus, as in use, with identity services exposed as secure APIs to third-party systems.

Benin's deck reports successful integration of more than 120 systems through the PNI (XROAD BJ), including the Public Services Portal, the ANIP natural persons registry, e-Tax and Insurance for the Poor.
